The parcel-request-type vocabulary. **Customer** parcel creation may use `1` (Send parcel), `2` (Self-storage) and `3` (Customer-to-customer); **business** creation is fixed to `6` (Ramassage sur place); `7`, `8`, `9` are business/dispatch; `4` is the kiosk appless flow. Labels are served trimmed.
